name: shaped
description: Use when you know the shape of the change but want a second reader before it ships — the cost of being wrong is worth catching but not worth a plan gate. Implement, then a review agent checks it and can send it back for revision under budget; a human reads the verdict before the PR is opened. Not for work small enough that the test suite alone is review (mechanical), or whose approach still needs deciding before anyone builds it (planned).

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task; the transition commits its work

stages.name: review
stages.description: Review agent checks quality and test coverage before the human reads the verdict
stages.prompt: Review branch $BRANCH against base $BASE_REF. This workflow routes results by named exits, not kanna_request_revision (which this task refuses for agent-origin calls). Record your verdict with kanna_complete_stage: status "success", your findings as the message, and exit "revise" for blocking findings, which sends the branch back to "in progress" under its own budget. A pass is status "success" with no exit, which advances to pr once a person confirms it. Never call kanna_request_revision on this task.

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR and hands off to the merge master
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the reviewed work on branch $BRANCH.
